public.title: Basic Calculator
public.description: Evaluate a valid expression containing decimal nonnegative integer literals, +, -, parentheses and ASCII spaces. Unary + or - is allowed wherever an operand is expected, including repeated signs. There is no multiplication or division. Expression length is 1 to 500; nesting is at most 100; all intermediate values have magnitude at most 1000000000.
hints: Parse a signed atom as a literal or parenthesized sum.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Recursive descent follows the addition/subtraction grammar and applies unary signs before combining terms. O(n) time and O(nesting) stack.
